laneNotes.note: Offline feature-card aggregates can be mirrored into DuckDB later for batch analysis and reporting.
Durable feature-card documents can be persisted to CouchDB later for offline sync and docstore-style lookups.
Frontend inference and assistant registration should consume the same JSON cards without changing the schema.

recommendations.title: Keep rich feature-card fields aligned across generators
recommendations.details: 19 feature cards already carry modules/imports/dependencies and lane metadata. Keep the contract stable so later multi-query passes can reuse it.
recommendations.nextAction: Use this report as the input contract for any new offline DuckDB or CouchDB mirror.

recommendations.title: Keep offline lanes explicit but non-blocking
recommendations.details: 4 cards already signal offline or fallback lanes. Keep those as evaluated paths rather than request-path dependencies.
recommendations.nextAction: Mirror the same cards into offline stores later, then keep runtime reads on the authoritative Postgres/Redis path.
